summary: Wave 12 (D2D for all 3 product types + verification gate + image-optional + bulk-company + landing stats) — backend + frontend tested. Backend pytest: 8/11 pass, 1 skipped (cascade), 2 FAILED. Found TWO blocking backend bugs: (1) GET /api/d2d/me 500s for any approved supplier because the route queries a non-existent column `suppliers.is_approved` — this completely breaks the verification gate on /dealer for legitimate dealers (Supabase returns 'column suppliers.is_approved does not exist'). (2) POST /api/supplier/printers still rejects payloads without image_url at the Pydantic layer (PrinterListingCreate.image_url: str), returning 422 before the endpoint's image-optional code path is reached — spec said printer create should no longer 400 on missing image. Everything else verified working: /d2d/listings public aggregator returns well-formed shape with counts and graceful-degrades on missing columns; /d2d/me unauth → 403; /d2d/me as buyer → {verified:false, reason:'not_supplier'}; toner + paper creates succeed without image_url; PUT /supplier/papers/{id} with d2d body → 503 with migration-pending message (correct graceful path); POST /mps/inquiry with selections.type=bulk_enquiry + company=Acme Corp → {ok:true}. Frontend: landing stats strip has all 4 testids (stat-marketplace #1 Marketplace, stat-suppliers 500+ Dealers, stat-cities 10+ Cities, stat-brands 15+ Brands) with computed fontFamily 'Helvetica, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif'; /dealer as guest renders dealer-verification-gate + dealer-gate-cta ('Become a verified dealer'); /oem is open to all (no gate, page renders 'OEM Partner Showcase'); /bulk has bulk-company input + bulk-credit-note with the exact 30-day-credit copy. Supplier-dashboard D2DRow / D2DExplainer / image-picker-removal could not be visually verified end-to-end because the same supplier-bootstrap path hits backend bug #1 (verification gate failure) and bug #2 (cannot create new printers without image) — main agent should re-test these UI surfaces after both backend fixes.

critical.issue: Returns 500 for approved suppliers — server.py line 815 selects column `is_approved` from suppliers, but Supabase suppliers table has no such column. Error: "column suppliers.is_approved does not exist (42703)". This breaks the entire /dealer verification gate. FIX: derive verified=true from row presence in `suppliers` table (matches existing _supplier_id_for logic) OR add the column via migration.

Pydantic schema PrinterListingCreate.image_url is declared `str` (required) at server.py line 1517. Spec said printer image is now optional. Endpoint logic (line 1639) uses `payload.image_url or ''` but never runs because 422 is raised first. FIX: change to `image_url: Optional[str] = ''` (or None).

CRITICAL: Make PrinterListingCreate.image_url optional in server.py line 1517 (`image_url: Optional[str] = ''`). The endpoint already handles empty/None correctly downstream.
After both fixes, re-run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_wave12.py (expect 11/11 green) and re-verify the Supplier-Dashboard Printers tab D2DRow + image-picker-removal on Add Printer form.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /d2d/me uses `maybe_single().execute()` which raises if zero rows in current supabase-py — consider `.execute()` + manual data check for safer empty-row handling.
Three nearly-identical d2d PUT blocks (lines ~3335/3400/3487) are copy-pasted across listings/printers/papers — extract into a shared helper to satisfy the DRY guideline.
server.py is 3960 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Suggest splitting D2D, papers, printers, MPS into separate routers.
PaperCreate is well-modelled (image_url Optional) but PrinterListingCreate diverges by making image_url required — inconsistent with the rest of the codebase and the wave-12 spec.

The two CRITICAL bugs documented above are blockers — until /d2d/me is fixed, no logged-in supplier can pass the /dealer gate; until PrinterListingCreate.image_url is optional, no printer can be created via the spec-compliant no-image flow. rca of the issue: BUG 1 root cause: server.py line 815 hard-codes a `select('id,business_name,is_approved')` on the suppliers table; the live Supabase schema tracks approval via the suppliers_pending.status column instead (the suppliers table contains only approved dealers — confirmed by reading admin/suppliers/{id}/approve at line 1446 which inserts into suppliers AFTER approval). Mitigation: replace the select+is_approved check with mere row-presence (`if s.data: verified=true`). Reproduction: login as approved supplier → GET /api/d2d/me → 500. Postgres error 42703.  BUG 2 root cause: PrinterListingCreate model still declares `image_url: str` (line 1517) so FastAPI validates before reaching the endpoint body where image_url is treated as optional. Mitigation: `image_url: Optional[str] = ''`. Reproduction: POST /api/supplier/printers without image_url → 422 with pydantic 'Field required'.
